besluite.fout: The two gods are introduced in mismatched patterns (title before Ra, appositive after Anubis), so 'die songod Ra en Anubis' can be read on first pass as both being sun gods.
besluite.rede: Same words, same gods and same descriptions in a parallel name-then-description pattern that a Grade 5 reader cannot misparse; protected words Ra, songod, Anubis and mummifisering are untouched, and the comma before 'en' closes an inserted phrase rather than sitting in a list.
